entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca lets you run a fleet of bots with your own subscription (e.g. Claude Code, Grok, Agy, Codex). Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 6,040 star（日均约 863，相对存量增速 4.6%），累计 131,574 star、8,366 fork。窗口内被 fork 468 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，468 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 6,040 stars over the last 7 days (~863/day, 4.6% of its base), now at 131,574 stars and 8,366 forks. 468 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 468 contributors.

intro.zh: Orca 是一个开源 Agent IDE，让你用自己的 Claude Code、Codex 等订阅跑一支机器人舰队。在 Slack、Linear 或 GitHub 里派活，回来就能收到测试过的 PR；桌面、手机、远程运行时都能用，笔记本合盖任务也不停。
intro.en: Orca is an open-source agent IDE that lets you run a fleet of bots on your own Claude Code or Codex subscription. Hand a task to a bot in Slack, Linear, or GitHub and come back to a tested pull request. It works on desktop, mobile, and remote runtimes, so work keeps going even when your laptop sleeps.

cardLine.zh: 开源 Agent IDE，用自己的订阅跑机器人舰队，派活收 PR。
cardLine.en: Open-source agent IDE: run a bot fleet on your own subscription, delegate and get PRs back.

highlights.zh: 在 Slack、Linear、GitHub 里让 bot 修 bug，回来直接拿测试过的 PR
highlights.en: Ask a bot in Slack, Linear, or GitHub to fix a bug and get back a tested PR

highlights.zh: 同一对话可在 Chat 界面和终端 CLI 间切换，上下文不丢
highlights.en: Move a conversation between the Chat UI and raw CLI without losing context

highlights.zh: 并行 worktree 隔离环境，多个 agent 互不干扰同时干活
highlights.en: Parallel worktrees isolate environments so multiple agents work side by side

highlights.zh: 手机 App 远程盯任务，agent 需要你时收到推送随时回复
highlights.en: Mobile app pings you when an agent needs input so work keeps moving

cons.zh: 开放 issue 8,971 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 8,971 open issues — high relative to its star count

# 摘自 stablyai/orca 的 README
# macOS (Homebrew)

brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Upgrade an existing install
brew upgrade --cask stablyai/orca/orca
# Release candidates (conflicts with the stable cask; uninstall it first)
brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca@rc

# Arch Linux (AUR) — or stably-orca-git to build from source
yay -S stably-orca-bin

entries.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

intro.zh: ECC 给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 agent 装上一套工程化系统：先规划再动手、用测试验证改动、从新上下文自审代码，还能记住重点、把重复经验沉淀成可复用技能。装一次，处处生效。

Install once and it becomes part of how your agent works.

entries.name: ponytail
entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 4,760 star（日均约 680，相对存量增速 2.4%），累计 196,045 star、11,039 fork。窗口内被 fork 390 次，最近一次提交在 23 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 156 个、issue 200 个，132 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 4,760 stars over the last 7 days (~680/day, 2.4% of its base), now at 196,045 stars and 11,039 forks. 390 new forks in the window; last push 23 day(s) ago; 156 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 132 contributors.

intro.zh: Ponytail 让 AI agent 学「最懒资深工程师」的思路：只写任务必需的代码，但绝不砍验证、错误处理和安全。基准测试中代码量降到 53%、token 省 45%，风险逻辑带测试的比例反而从 68% 升到 98%。
intro.en: Ponytail teaches your agent to think like the laziest senior dev: write only what the task needs, but never cut validation, error handling, or security. In benchmarks, code dropped to 53% and tokens to 55%, while risky logic shipping with tests rose from 68% to 98%.

cardLine.zh: 让 agent 只写必要代码的技能，省 token 又不砍测试和安全。
cardLine.en: A skill that makes agents write only necessary code, without cutting tests or security.

highlights.zh: 典型案例：日期选择器从 335 行缩到 10 行，复用现有组件
highlights.en: Signature case: a date picker cut from 335 lines to 10 by reusing what exists

highlights.zh: /ponytail-review 像「出事要背锅」的资深工程师那样审代码
highlights.en: /ponytail-review reads the code your change touches, not just the diff

highlights.zh: /ponytail-audit 先摸清全仓库结构，再按优先级列出该修什么
highlights.en: /ponytail-audit maps the whole repo first, then ranks what to fix

highlights.zh: 六项安全任务 30 次全过：代码更少，安全性不打折
highlights.en: Passed all 30 runs on six security tasks: less code, no less safe

intro.zh: Impeccable 给 coding agent 一套设计词汇：用 polish、bolder 等指令精确指挥界面风格，用 critique、audit 做设计评审。内置 62 条确定性规则当「AI slop 检测器」，不用 LLM、不要 API key，赶在上线前抓住千篇一律的 AI 页面。
intro.en: Impeccable gives your coding agent a design vocabulary: steer style with commands like polish and bolder, review with critique and audit. Its 62 deterministic rules act as an AI slop detector — no LLM, no API key — catching generic AI pages before they ship.

cardLine.zh: 给 coding agent 的设计词汇表，指挥风格、评审设计、拦截 AI slop。

highlights.zh: critique 按可用性启发式打分排序，audit 查无障碍与响应式
highlights.en: critique scores usability heuristics; audit checks accessibility and responsive behavior

highlights.zh: 62 条确定性规则检测 AI slop，无需 LLM 和 API key
highlights.en: 62 deterministic rules flag AI slop with no LLM and no API key

highlights.zh: init 生成 PRODUCT.md、document 沉淀 DESIGN.md，改动不跑偏

highlights.en: Code parsing is deterministic and fully local: no LLM calls, nothing leaves your machine

intro.zh: PPT Master 让 AI 把文档或主题做成真正原生的 PowerPoint：形状、切换、动画都是原生元素，图表表格有数据支撑，还能按演讲者备注生成配音，支持套用你自己的 .pptx 模板，产出可在 PowerPoint 里继续编辑。
intro.en: PPT Master has AI turn documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks: native shapes, transitions, and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates — all editable in PowerPoint afterward.

cardLine.zh: AI 把文档变成原生可编辑的 PPTX，带动画、图表和配音。
cardLine.en: AI turns documents into native, editable PPTX decks with animations, charts, and narration.

highlights.zh: 生成原生形状、切换和动画，不是截图式假 PPT
highlights.en: Generates native shapes, transitions, and animations — not screenshot-style slides

highlights.zh: 图表和表格基于数据生成，需要时按需加入
highlights.en: Charts and tables are data-backed and added on demand

highlights.zh: 按演讲者备注生成音频旁白，直接能拿去讲
highlights.en: Creates audio narration from speaker notes, ready to present

highlights.zh: 支持导入自己的 .pptx 模板，保持团队既有风格
highlights.en: Supports your own .pptx templates to keep your team's existing style

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

entries.name: archify
entries.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,873 star（日均约 268，相对存量增速 1.9%），累计 98,488 star、6,729 fork。窗口内被 fork 143 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，86 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,873 stars over the last 7 days (~268/day, 1.9% of its base), now at 98,488 stars and 6,729 forks. 143 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 86 contributors.

intro.zh: Archify 是一个 agent 技能，把想法、计划或代码库变成可交互的 HTML 图表：一句话让 agent 读完仓库画出架构图，节点可点击、可跳源码。不用仓库也行，旅行行程、学习地图都能画，还能导出长图或 PDF 分享。
intro.en: Archify is an agent skill that turns an idea, plan, or codebase into interactive HTML diagrams: one sentence gets your agent to read a repo and map its architecture, with clickable nodes linking to source. No repo needed either — travel plans and learning maps work too, exportable as long images or PDF.

cardLine.zh: 把想法或代码库变成可交互图表的 agent 技能，可跳源码。
cardLine.en: An agent skill that turns ideas or codebases into interactive diagrams with source links.

highlights.zh: 一句话让 agent 读仓库，生成带源码链接的架构图
highlights.en: One sentence gets a source-backed architecture diagram from your repo

highlights.zh: 追问式改图：加认证、高亮缓存未命中路径、换主题
highlights.en: Iterate by asking: add auth, highlight the cache-miss path, switch themes

highlights.zh: 解释页结论先行，论断带编号引用并固定到具体 commit
highlights.en: Explainers lead with the conclusion and cite sources pinned to a commit

highlights.zh: 单个 HTML 文件即分享，可导出 PNG 长图或打印成 PDF
highlights.en: Share one HTML file, or export a PNG long image or print to PDF

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

fitFor.zh: 要把 Agent 能力嵌进自己产品的开发者
fitFor.en: Developers embedding agent capabilities into their own product

fitFor.zh: 需要可扩展抽象层而非端到端方案的团队
fitFor.en: Teams wanting an extensible abstraction layer rather than a turnkey app
